title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: Finally free of construction, the Spanish capital is once again a welcome destination for walkers who want to explore its many sights.

title: 36 Hours in Shanghai
abstract: Now that the Beijing Olympics are but a memory, the spotlight in China is moving to Shanghai as that city gears up to host the 2010 World Expo.

title: 36 Hours in Doha, Qatar
abstract: Still plump with petrodollars, the home of the Al Jazeera network has been bingeing on luxury hotels and cultural venues designed by top-shelf architects.

title: 36 Hours in Majorca
abstract: Prepare to be hypnotized by ancient terraced landscapes, tiny medieval villages and extraordinary food on this mountainous, gnarled island.

title: 36 Hours in Hanoi
abstract: The Vietnam city has evolved from a grim, famine-ravaged place into a sophisticated metropolis with high-rises, sensational cuisine and world-class art.
